# Desklib

> > Desklib is an AI-powered academic platform providing intelligent study tools, document libraries, and automated grading for students worldwide.

Desklib offers a comprehensive suite of AI-driven tools designed to enhance student learning, from assignment grading and plagiarism detection to personalized tutoring and research automation. The platform combines access to millions of free study documents with cutting-edge AI technologies including ChatGPT, Gemini Pro, and Claude integration.

## Key Topics

- AI Grader
- Plagiarism Checker
- AI Paraphraser
- AI Code Checker
- AI Researcher
- AI Quiz
- AI Learner

- Academic Writing

## AI-Powered Study Tools

- [AI Grader](https://desklib.com/ai-grader): AI Grader providing instant feedback on assignments with detailed evaluations.
- [AI Paraphraser](https://desklib.com/ai-paraphraser): AI Paraphraser tool for rephrasing content with contextual understanding.
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://desklib.com/plagiarism-checker): Free plagiarism detection tool for ensuring content originality and academic integrity.
- [AI Content Detector](https://desklib.com/ai-content-detector): AI detector tool for identifying AI-generated content and ensuring writing originality.
- [AI Code Checker](https://desklib.com/ai-code-checker): AI Code Checker for analyzing programming assignments across multiple languages.
- [AI Quiz](https://desklib.com/ai-quiz): AI Quiz tool for creating flashcards and quizzes from study materials.

## Learning & Research Tools

- [AI Learner](https://desklib.com/ai-learner): AI Learner for personalized tutoring, podcasts, and interactive learning from documents.
- [AI Researcher](https://desklib.com/ai-researcher): AI Researcher tool for automating research process and generating detailed reports.
- [AI Answer](https://desklib.com/ai-answer): Unified interface accessing ChatGPT, Gemini Pro, Claude, and other AI models.
- [Document Comparison](https://desklib.com/writing/compare): Document comparison tool for plagiarism detection and similarity checking.

## Study Resources & Library

- [Study Documents](https://desklib.com/study-documents): Library of millions of free study documents and resources from students worldwide.
- [Study Documents Archive](https://desklib.com/study-documents/archive): Archived study documents and historical academic resources library.
